name: Border States
old_description: The Chicago branch proudly serves the construction, industrial and utility markets.
about:
Border States’ Chicago branch operates from a facility on West Ferdinand Street in Chicago, Illinois. The company has served construction, industrial, and utility markets for more than 70 years and is structured as a 100 % employee‑owned enterprise. No founding year or individual founders are disclosed in the available materials.

The branch functions as a full‑service distributor and solutions provider. Its offerings span back‑office and financial streamlining, building information modeling (BIM), equipment maintenance and testing, customized kitting, prefabricated modular switchboard and panel assembly, material management, project management, Rockwell Automation repair and remanufacturing, on‑site staffing and advanced logistics (4PL/5PL), technical advisory and assessments, training in automation and natural gas, utility metering (AMR/AMI), and customized wire and cable services. The company does not publish facility square footage, headcount, or annual volume figures.

Primary customers are contractors, industrial plants, and utility operators in the construction, industrial, and utility sectors. The quality blog illustrates how crews rely on the distributor for guy‑wire anchors used in transmission and cell‑tower installations. The company’s “Trusted by industry leaders” list references supplier brands such as 3M, Lithonia Lighting, Leviton, Encore Wire, Southwire, and Prysmian Group, indicating the product lines it carries for those markets.

Border States emphasizes its employee‑ownership model as a differentiator, stating that dedicated owners are invested in customer success. The company pledges accountability, expertise, relationship‑based collaboration, flexibility, and transparency, aiming to treat each client’s business as its own.
